name: Covenant Of Morn
source:
You are resurrected by a white-haired witch that offers you a deal. Her blood to keep you alive, in return for helping her with an important mission. A mission to murder her very own sister. Soon you are plunged into a world full of magic and mystery, learn that there is more to it all than meets the eye, and that receiving "her blood" means sharing the witche's bed.

[From [url=https://395games.itch.io/childrenofmorn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位白发女巫将你复活，并为你提供了一笔交易。她的鲜血让你活下去，作为帮助她完成一项重要任务的回报。谋杀她亲生妹妹的任务。很快你就会陷入一个充满魔法和神秘的世界，你会发现这一切远比你看到的要复杂，接受“她的血”就意味着和女巫同床共枕。

[来自[url=https://395games.itch.io/childrenofmorn]Itch.io[/url]]
